title: Harley Quinn Rebirth Lot of 33 DC 2016 #5-35 47 51 Frank Cho Variants Conner
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright, spines and staples intact; light handling wear. #15 is still sealed in its original polybag. Every cover pictured.
descriptionText:
Harley Quinn (DC Comics, 2016 DC Universe Rebirth series) by Amanda Conner and Jimmy Palmiotti, with Paul Dini "Harley Loves Joker" backups - 33 comics. $2.99 cover price each.

You get:
- #5, 6, 7, 8, 9 ("Undercover Punker")
- #11, 12, 13 ("Joker Loves Harley")
- #13 Frank Cho variant cover
- #14 and #14 Frank Cho variant cover
- #15 - sealed in original polybag with AMC Into the Badlands preview
- #16 through #24 ("Nether Regions", "Red Meat", "Blast from the Future", "The Family Circles")
- #26 through #35
- #47 and #51

Not included: #1-4, #10, #25, #36-46, #48-50.

See photos: the first four show every cover in the lot. Ships bagged together in a box.
